about: UO Bench, version 1: decision models playing Ultima Online, by shard rules, profession and task. A player's score on a track is its share of points (a win 1, a draw 1/2) over the track's matches, with a 95% interval from a bootstrap over runs (the rounds of one run share its arena and seating, so they are not independent). A score counts as settled once that interval is within 3 points either way. Bench runs are kept apart from the training loop's selection, so that no score comes from rounds a selection has seen.

ml/duel-mage.about: Mage against the scripted mage at matched speed (it reacts in 40 ms), on five arenas, from both seats.

ml/duel-dexer.about: Dexer (sword and shield) against the scripted dexer at matched speed, on five arenas, from both seats.

ml/duel-archer.about: Archer against the scripted archer at matched speed, on five arenas, from both seats.
